title: Lemo Parts Spec
description: The illustrative parts list a teardown clip is built from. It names the product and its parts and the order they separate along one axis. It is a diagram specification, never a measured engineering drawing.

product.description: The product the parts belong to.

illustrative.description: Always true: the parts are a diagram, not a measured model. No dimension, tolerance or torque may be inferred from it.

parts.description: The parts, in separation order along the axis.

id.description: Stable identifier used by the clip.

name.description: Short noun label shown beside the part.

layer.description: Position of the part along the explode axis; parts sharing a layer move together.

count.description: How many of this part: one for a plate, many for fasteners.
